#  12819 - Seminar: Fields, Waves and Matter Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12819 - module is no longer offered from SS 2022**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Seminar: Fields, Waves and Matter**  |  
|  Seminar: Felder, Wellen und Materie   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Gardill, Markus 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students know how to familiarize themselves with a specific new topic and establish a sound understanding of it. They have acquired the skill to prepare a lecture, present it to an audience and defend it in a thorough discussion.  |  
| Contents:  | The topic and presentation are from the fields of electrodynamics, physical electronics, radio frequency engineering, and plasma science (e.g., interaction of electromagnetic radiation with matter), including:
  * Electromagnetic radiation
  * Phenomenology of light propagation in matter
  * Interaction of light and matter
  * Magnetic phenomena, constitutive relations, and plasmas
  * Quantum description of absorption, emission, and light scattering
  * Spectroscopy
  * Optical cavities, stability, lasers
  * Nonlinear optics
  * Fiber optics and optical communication systems

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of the topics of modules:
  * 11107 Mathematics - T1
  * 11108 Mathematics - T2
  * 11206 Mathematics - T3
  * 12283 Electrical and Magnetic Fields
  * 12284 Electrodynamics

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 135 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Y. Band, Light and Matter: Electromagnetism, Optics, Spectroscopy and Lasers (Wiley, 2006)
  * A. Zangwill, Modern Electrodynamics (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
  * J.T. Verdeyen, Laser Electronics (Prentice Hall, 1995)

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Active attendance of seminar lectures (25%)
  * Presentation, 30-45 min. (75%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Seminar Fields, Waves and Matter

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 11.02.2022 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
